avis.titre: Didn't Work for Me but Would Recommend
avis.texte: I wanted to write a review since there's none on here and I think this product needs some recognition! You get a good amount of product and I think it's great and gentle even for sensitive skin. Unfortunately, I have very reactive skin, so this did make my extra sensitive areas tingle a bit so that's why I returned it. But, I think the average person with a normal level of skin sensitivity would love this! Removed all my makeup effectively (be sure to gently press on your eyelid for a few seconds for waterproof makeup). I was nervous about seeing "salicylic acid" in the ingredients list, but after some research I learned the formula includes a derivative of the SA that gently exfoliates skin cells on the surface that are already dead, unlike regular SA. Even after the first use, I noticed my skin felt super soft, and I will miss that about using this. I would encourage every skin type to try this out! Great cleansing water to remove makeup and SPF gentler than cleansing oil would.
